atoms.name: Relaxation and distance
atoms.one_line: d[v] = min(d[v], d[u] + w); triangle inequality.

atoms.name: Unit and 0-1 weights
atoms.one_line: BFS (or 0-1 BFS with a deque) in $O(V+E)$.

atoms.name: Dijkstra
atoms.one_line: Greedy; needs non-negative weights; array O(V²), heap O((V+E)log V).

atoms.name: Bellman-Ford
atoms.one_line: V−1 rounds, O(VE); detects negative cycles; k rounds = at most k edges.

atoms.name: Shortest paths in a DAG
atoms.one_line: Topological order, relax once: Θ(V+E), negative edges allowed.

atoms.name: Floyd-Warshall
atoms.one_line: DP over intermediate vertices; Θ(V³); all pairs.

atoms.name: Properties and traps
atoms.one_line: Subpaths optimal; potentials preserve paths; adding a constant does not; ties and edge limits.

patterns.name: Transform weights: add constant, reweight, scale
